command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '%s\n' '=== local runner ==='
hostname
printf 'repo_head=' && git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'repo_branch=' && git branch --show-current
printf 'repo_dirty=' && if test -n "$(git status --porcelain)"; then echo yes; git status --short; else echo no; fi
printf '%s\n' '=== ssh raspberry pi ==='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; echo ssh=ok; printf hostname=; hostname; printf arch=; uname -m; cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; printf repo_branch=; git branch --show-current; printf repo_head=; git rev-parse HEAD; printf repo_dirty=; if test -n "$(git status --porcelain)"; then echo yes; git status --short; else echo no; fi; printf service=; systemctl is-active photomap.service || true; echo ---service---; systemctl --no-pager --full status photomap.service 2>&1 | sed -n "1,18p"; echo ---unit---; systemctl cat photomap.service 2>&1 | sed -n "1,120p"; echo ---tools---; command -v python3 || true; command -v node || true; command -v npm || true'
printf '%s\n' '=== public site ==='
curl -fsS -L -o /tmp/photomap-readiness.html -w 'https_status=%{http_code} total=%{time_total}s size=%{size_download}\n' https://photomap.pl/
head -c 180 /tmp/photomap-readiness.html | tr '\n' ' '; echo
printf '%s\n' '=== screenshot/test capability ==='
cd frontend
printf 'node=' && node --version
printf 'npm=' && npm --version
npx playwright --version
node -e "const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test'); console.log('playwright_import=ok', Boolean(chromium));"
if test -d "$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright"; then find "$HOME/.cache/ms-playwright" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d -printf '%f\n' | sort | head -20; else echo playwright_browser_cache=missing; fi
